title: CANON-1 Canonical Bundle Index
summary: Pins the canonical set of contract bundles and artifact hashes for the V42 Enterprise Ticketing suite. CI and agents use this as the authoritative suite index to prevent drift.

canonical_meta.intent: Pin exact bundle and artifact hashes for the suite; treat as immutable once locked.
canonical_meta.note: CANON-1 does not pin itself; CI must exclude the canon bundle from self-pin checks.

planned_docs.purpose: Administrative Operations. Governs privileged actions (refund, ban, impersonate) with break-glass controls and auditability.
key_points: Sudo-mode / step-up auth for high-risk actions; mandatory reason codes.
Four-eyes approval for bulk/destructive actions above thresholds.
No invariant bypass: admin actions MUST still use domain actions (no raw deletes).

planned_docs.purpose: Business Intelligence & Reporting. Governs analytical read-models, metric definitions, and OLTP/OLAP isolation.
key_points: FORBIDS heavy analytics on OLTP writer; mandates read replica and/or OLAP store.
Defines Metric Registry: every metric has a stable name, formula, source-of-truth, dimensionality, and freshness SLO.
Finance-grade metrics MUST reconcile to LED-1 (daily close + variance thresholds).
Tenant sealing: org_id scoping for organizer views; cross-tenant metrics restricted to platform admins only.
Read-model pipeline: EVT-1 outbox/events -> idempotent consumers -> reporting tables/materialized views.

planned_docs.purpose: Communications & Notifications. Governs email/SMS/WhatsApp/push pipelines, templates, and opt-outs.
key_points: Separates transactional vs marketing communications (CONSENT-1 enforced).
Idempotent delivery via DP-1 outbox; retries with backoff and provider failover rules.
Template versioning and localization rules; audit trail for critical sends.

planned_docs.purpose: Consent & Privacy Preferences. Governs lawful basis, purpose limitations, regional consent policies, and how consent is stored and enforced.
key_points: Models consent by purpose (necessary, analytics, marketing, personalization) with versioned policy text references.
Supports signals: user settings, CMP banner state, Global Privacy Control (GPC) where applicable.
Defines enforcement points: TRK-1 event capture, COMM-1 marketing sends, pixel firing.
Defines default posture: GDPR-grade baseline, with optional stricter overrides per region.

planned_docs.purpose: Data Subject Access Requests. Defines export, correction, and erasure flows without breaking immutability of LED-1.
key_points: Identity verification + audit trail for DSAR requests; rate-limit to prevent abuse.
Deletion uses PII shredding/tombstones; LED-1 postings are immutable (only redact PII references).
Analytics/read-models must store pseudonymous keys so DSAR can delete linkage without corrupting aggregates.
Defines deadlines and response envelopes; integrates with COMM-1 for notifications.

planned_docs.purpose: Frontend Architecture & BFF Governance. Prevents business logic leakage into UI and defines how LiveView interacts with Ash.
key_points: No direct Repo/Ecto in *_web; all reads/writes go through Ash Domains/Resources.
Defines BFF boundaries, caching tiers, and per-widget rate limits for dashboards.
Requires actor + tenant propagation (IAM-1 + TEN-1).

planned_docs.purpose: Feature Registry. Locks product scope and blocks unplanned/zombie features from being implemented by agents.
key_points: Defines authoritative feature list, feature flags, and rollout stages (planned/approved/in_build/live/deprecated).
Each feature MUST declare dependencies on contracts (e.g., TAX-1, PAY-*, BI-1) before implementation can start.
CI/gov lint MUST fail if code references a feature not present in FR-1 (drift prevention).

planned_docs.purpose: Integrations & Webhooks. Governs third-party integrations, credential rotation, signing, retries, and rate limits.
key_points: Defines webhook signing (HMAC) and replay protection (nonce + timestamp).
Credentials MUST be rotatable; least-privilege scopes.
Outbound requests MUST be idempotent and routed through DP-1 outbox.

planned_docs.purpose: Financial Reconciliation. Defines daily close, provider statement import, and variance handling between BI read-models and LED-1.
key_points: Daily reconciliation of BI totals vs LED-1 postings; drift thresholds and alerting.
Provider statement ingestion + matching rules; unresolved items workflow.
Locks historical periods (monthly close) while allowing controlled adjustments via explicit correction postings.

planned_docs.purpose: Tracking & Attribution. Defines event taxonomy for product analytics (UTM, funnels) and pixel/partner integrations without privacy drift.
key_points: Defines first-party tracking event schema (page_view, checkout_started, purchase_completed, etc.) with strict snake_case keys.
UTM builder + URL shortener: canonical attribution fields and dedupe keys.
Regional collection modes (EU vs SA) MUST be policy-driven by CONSENT-1 and geo context; fail-closed.
Anti-abuse: rate-limits, bot filtering, and idempotency for tracking events.
